text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (April 05, 2026) for 64 St. Clair Ave West.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (April 5, 2026), for 64 St. Clair Avenue West, Folder No. 26 139079 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to September 15, 2026.
